items.title: Illumina (ILMN) Stock May Be A Bargain Despite Singapore Genome Win
items.summary: Illumina has seen its stock swing sharply in recent years, and with cash flows sitting at the center of the story, the question now is whether the current price lines up with what the business is likely to generate over time. Over the past 3 years, Illumina has delivered a 111.2% share price gain. This puts a lot of weight on whether the underlying cash flows can support that kind of re-rating. items.title: Illumina (ILMN) Wins The 2026 Virtual Cell Challenge
items.summary: Illumina (NasdaqGS:ILMN) said its BioInsight AI Lab won the 2026 Virtual Cell Challenge with its CellularAI platform. The competition recognized CellularAI for using AI to predict cellular behavior from large scale biological datasets. Organizers highlighted the potential of CellularAI to support future drug discovery workflows and biomedical research programs. items.title: Is Illumina (ILMN) Undervalued Following Its Cybersecurity Recalls?
items.summary: Illumina (ILMN) is back in focus after a series of voluntary Class II recalls tied to cybersecurity vulnerabilities in several diagnostic sequencing instruments raised fresh questions about operational risk and data integrity. The cybersecurity recalls landed just as Illumina shares were already under pressure. The 1-day share price return was down 4.45% and the 30-day share price return was down 25.11%.
